graymere-county.name: Graymere County
graymere-county.description: River-and-marsh county of Valewyr, politically exposed and run-down despite wider peace. Contains one market town, eight villages, and scattered hamlets and crofts.
graymere-county.history:
Inherited by Ben after the previous count’s execution for treason.
Late winter travel is slow; thaw brings floods and bandit opportunity.

castle-harrowgate.name: Castle Harrowgate
castle-harrowgate.description: Old border-fort turned county seat: a lived-in noble castle with broad courtyard, great hall, and keep with apartments, but worn and understaffed. Includes gatehouse/wallwalk, armory, stores, and a half-ruined tower.
castle-harrowgate.history:
Now Ben’s seat by royal charter.
Operates on a skeleton crew with wages long in arrears.
Supplies and arms are modest and rationed.

eastbridge.name: Eastbridge
eastbridge.description: Market town by a stone bridge crossing and riverside docks; bridge tolls are the cleanest local coin. Governed locally via a Town Speaker, toll master, market wardens, and a shrine-keeper’s influence.
eastbridge.history:
Maintains a rotating town watch/militia of householders.
Likely held some monies locally during the prior count’s absence.
Expected first stop for Ben’s observation and local steward inquiries.

kingdom-of-valewyr.name: Kingdom of Valewyr
kingdom-of-valewyr.description: Feudal kingdom ruled by House Cauldrin, largely peaceful and prosperous at present. Graymere is one of its counties.
kingdom-of-valewyr.history:
Capital at Asterhall.
Crown expects taxes and obedience via personal rule and charters.

asterhall.name: Asterhall
asterhall.description: Capital of Valewyr and seat of House Cauldrin. Administrative center where Ben can request personnel and political support.
asterhall.history:
Destination of Holt’s sealed request for an estate clerk.
Home court of King Odran III and Princess Maeryn.
